1#א: Cooking. Meaning: but not by pickling or salting, which is not a way of cooking. {Rama: And roasting is included in cooking; and cold into hot is also a way of cooking; and pouring from a cooking vessel at least the measure of a shell; and smoked is like cooking; and cooked in Tiberias hot springs is not forbidden from the Torah. Peri Chadash}
1#ב: For benefit. Even rabbinically; Maharshal disagrees and rules forbidden for benefit; Shach challenged and wrote his words are not required; Taz also wrote we have only Rishonim and Acharonim. {Rama: Therefore fowl meat in milk without sixty may be given to a gentile; rennet forbidden for benefit — agreement of Rishonim and Acharonim unlike Maharshal stringent for benefit. Radbaz was asked about practice putting pure milk in sugar when cooking — craftsmen say two per hundred — permitted to eat sugar with meat because nullified in water and sugar — see Peri Chadash}
3#א: And for benefit. Shach wrote: but in eating without qualification forbidden d'oraisa because impure meat or impure milk — not basar b'chalav; Bach wrote rabbinically forbidden because of basar b'chalav; practical difference piece becoming nevelah — Mechaber siman 92 only meat and milk; likewise piece fit to honor guests; Taz challenged: R' Ephraim's reason in basar b'chalav is each alone permitted, mixtures forbidden becoming one body — not applicable to one impure species; piece fit to honor guests not applicable; Shach disagrees with Bach — see there.
3#ב: Rabbinically. Bach ruled fowl meat in milk is d'oraisa; Shach disagrees and brings Rambam: one who says fowl in milk d'oraisa violates bal tosif.
3#ג: Prohibition. Taz wrote nevertheless do not eat fish in milk because of danger as Orach Chaim siman 173 — error; only fish with meat forbidden for danger; fish with milk unheard and unseen; daily practice cook fish in milk; Gemara chapter Kol HaTzlamim explicit no danger — plain — end Shach.
3#ד: Almonds. Shach wrote: fish blood siman 66 permitted entirely; nevertheless in vessel forbidden marit ayin unless scales show fish blood — there blood d'oraisa; viewer may think animal blood d'oraisa; but actual fowl in milk rabbinic — no marit ayin; therefore must speak of cooking; otherwise domestic meat no d'oraisa prohibition without almonds; Maharshal ruled fowl in almond milk forbidden unless almonds placed; primary since even rabbinic marit ayin in many places — Orach Chaim siman 305 pair plugged lest appear going to market to sell — marit ayin though commerce Shabbat rabbinic — end; Taz: l'chatchila place almonds even by fowl; where no almonds do not forbid eating — all we can fix we fix.
4#_: To cook. Taz wrote not a fortiori since one forbidden alone — no marit ayin decree except when each alone permitted like almond milk with fowl; cannot lenient regarding Rama's stringency — end; Shach: what Taz wrote siman 63 permitted cooking and benefit is by law not marit ayin; difference where no marit ayin concern such as medical need; it appears to me to resolve all challenges of Taz and Shach on Rama — they ruled unlike him that fowl too has marit ayin concern; Rama discusses whole seif cooking not eating — questioned Rashba forbidding woman's milk marit ayin — not impure milk l'chatchila; doubted whether Gemara permitted cooking entirely without marit ayin or only by law; regarding fowl almond milk no concern lest violate cooking ox with milk unless mistake both — think fowl is ox and almonds real milk — Avodah Zarah no concern for both mistakes unless cook fowl in real milk — even then only rabbinic marit ayin; possibly permitted entirely in cooking as Gemara; such rabbinic marit ayin not found; resolves Shach's challenge from Orach Chaim Shabbat; Rama certainly forbids eating lest eat fowl in milk rabbinically; pure meat with impure milk likewise lest cook pure with pure d'oraisa; whole seif only cooking; end fowl rabbinic no concern same — investigate.
5#א: Entangled. Shach wrote: above siman 86 seif 4 striking chicken — eggs forbidden eiver min ha'chai if entangled — considered meat; different here rabbinic basar b'chalav leniency; also no question — without verse 'land flowing with milk' milk would be eiver min ha'chai; verse permitted milk not attached; entangled eggs remain prohibited; never called meat for this — clear — end; Taz in name of Maharshal: there not taste-dependent — Maharshal himself wrote strained; whenever entangled considered meat for all matters; Mahari Weil: women forbid even hard outer shell; l'chatchila only; b'dieved when shell complete even white membrane suffices — no meat law — end; Shach: nevertheless if only yolk completed and entangled — lenient in great loss.
5#ב: To cook them. Shach wrote wording imprecise — cooking alone obviously permitted even fowl siman 63; 'to cook them' means to eat them. {Rama: Custom: Acharonim forbid any eggs found in fowl with milk even hard shell — Maharshal, Bach, Beit Yosef; b'dieved completed in white membrane suffices — Taz in name of Mahari Weil}
5#ג: After them. Shach wrote: even still attached in spine — permitted to eat cheese afterward; salting these eggs explained above siman 87 see there.
6#א: No lashes. Shach wrote: nevertheless prohibition exists; all Mechaber's cases have at least prohibition.
6#ב: Dead. Meaning milk after death; whether died naturally or slaughtered.
6#ג: In milk. Shach wrote Rambam's wording; holds no lashes for basar b'chalav but for blood would lash — he holds cooked blood violated; we hold cooked/salted blood rabbinic siman 69; Bach: Rambam agrees — refers only to dead milk — no lashes basar b'chalav but would lash nevelah; {Rama: proof: same section male milk — certainly no blood liability — wording 'eating it' singular refers only to dead milk — investigate}
6#ד: General. Shach wrote appears no even rabbinic prohibition; Orach Chaim: no worse than woman's milk; Rav Maggid: male milk rabbinic — animal male milk; human male no worse than woman's milk; Mechaber and Rama do not dispute — Mechaber animal; Rama human. {Rama: nevertheless human l'chatchila marit ayin like woman's milk — investigate}
6#ה: And water. Orach Chaim wrote even milk-water after cheese forbids food.
6#ו: To stoke. Shach in name of Mordechai: forbidden cook forbidden meat in Israelite house in gentile pot lest Israelite stoke — two gentile maidservants two pots meat and milk; mere stringency — people not careful.
6#ז: For head-washing. Shach wrote: not forbidden for this since benefit — not eating not benefit from prohibition body — siman 94; siman 108 seif 4 hagahah; siman 155 hagahah.
6#ח: Pots. Sage wrote metal pots need not be stringent l'chatchila — splash returns white by fire — end. {Rama: question Rama forbidding stoke under gentile pot — they cook meat and milk — how permit ash water for head-washing — Rama wrote habit basar b'chalav mix — cooking basar b'chalav when heating water — investigate} siman 95 seif 4 Taz proves ash noten taam lifgam — why forbid pot for head water — noten taam lifgam no basar b'chalav {Rama: may reject noten taam lifgam l'chatchila forbidden — investigate}
7#_: Exempt. But prohibition in cooking and eating.
8#_: General. See siman 81 seif 5 what Shach wrote there — Shulchan Aruch words do not contradict — see there.
9#א: In stomach. Derives from food category — considered excrement and filth.
9#ב: That forbids. Shach: clear; Rama wrote and so they practice; sage: l'chatchila permitted dried; clear — b'dieved forbidden; l'chatchila forbidden even dried marit ayin; Maharshal: even dried actual milk by law; Ran; Orach Chaim.
10#א: Salted. Shach wrote must stand in salting until placed on fire and boils siman 69 seif 18; salted until inedible from salt siman 91 seif 5; even for us salting forbids immediately — nevertheless b'dieved if set rennet when not salted so much — many poskim consider excrement even clear — end. {Rama: Peri Chadash: even for us must stand in salting to forbid all; forbid peel measure immediately; if forbidden amount can set alone — permitted}
10#ב: Day. Meaning by itself — like pickled like cooked.
10#ג: Sixty. Shach wrote apparently difficult why sixty suffices — setting agent even in thousand not nullified; say only setting agent forbidden in itself like nevelah not nullified; here forbidden only by basar b'chalav mixture — nullifies; even actual basar b'chalav by cooking considered substance — here only salting/pickling rabbinic — Rav holds not substance for any amount setting {Rama: see Darkei Moshe Knesset HaGedolah resolutions}
10#ד: Lenient. Shach wrote permit even kosher stomach nursed tereifah when clear congealed in great loss — many poskim permit clear — rely on them; though some stringent even dried — here clear congealed lenient in great loss.
10#ה: And they dry. Shach wrote same for other innards dried like wood; l'chatchila should not.
11#א: Taste. {Rama: meaning no sixty in cheese against skin — follows view siman 98 rely on gentile taste} We do not rely on gentile taste — always measure sixty; Rav hagahah: wording 'if sixty' — investigate.
11#ב: Nevelah. Distinction poskim wrote: kosher stomach skin permitted alone — prohibition only joining cheese without taste — not basar b'chalav each alone; nevelah skin forbidden in itself when sets — seen as prohibition in existence.
11#ג: Permitted. Shach wrote specifically when prohibition cannot set alone without permitted — otherwise forbidden; requires study; see siman 143 seif 4 and seif 11 see there.
